extraction.Name: Earnest Charbonneau
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent recorded by Ella McHenry April 10, 1918
extraction.Buyer: Edward L. McHenry for consideration of $22,000
extraction.NOTES: Allottee is deceased. West half of section 12, township 97, north of range 75. Fee patent receipted for by allottee January 19, 1918. April 10, 1918, Ernest Charbonneau conveys land to Edward L. McHenry. Deed dated April 10, 1918.
